subbench.objective: Exercise RFC 5322 addr-spec recognition: the ambiguous decomposition of the local part against the domain, and the backreference tier that separates engines that have backrefs from engines that do not.

status_detail: The after-sample of /proc/loadavg (9.8) exceeds this run's limit (6.0): the box got busy partway through, so every number in this record is load-compromised and the record is NOT measured (requirements 9(a); the lesson is pcrec compare R3.10's -- a box quiet at the start can be loaded by the end, and one post-hoc sample cannot see the first case).
